# A struct's field named like a method of the component a test takes is the
# field: html read `c.label[0][1]` through the loop's `stage.forms`, and
# called it, since `forms` is one of the page's zero-argument methods, which
# a test reads off the instance as a field (MethodFields).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Stage {
    name  string
    forms list[string]
}

component page ui.node {
    var stages list[Stage] = [Stage{name="a", forms=["x", "y"]}]

    func forms() list[string] {
        return ["z"]
    }

    for var stage = stages {
        for var f = stage.forms {
            ui.text #label(value=f)
        }
    }
    ui.text(value="{forms().length()}")
}

func testAFieldNamedLikeAMethod(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.label[0][1] != null && c.label[0][1].value == "y")
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/page/1 --

    {
      "Desc": "AFieldNamedLikeAMethod",
      "Passed": true
